TMAT.description: Time Dependent Material (TMAT). Links a structural material to time-dependent property definitions by name: TDMT_NAME selects the creep/shrinkage (TDMT) definition and TDME_NAME selects the time-dependent elasticity / compressive-strength (TDME) definition; each name must match an existing definition of that kind.

TDMT_NAME.description: Name of the time-dependent creep/shrinkage material definition (TDMT) to link. Must be the name of an existing TDMT entry; the handler resolves it to a TDMT key and rejects an unknown name. Empty/omitted clears the creep/shrinkage link.

TDME_NAME.description: Name of the time-dependent elasticity (compressive-strength gain) material definition (TDME) to link. Must be the name of an existing TDME entry; the handler resolves it to a TDME key and rejects an unknown name. Empty/omitted clears the elasticity link.
